metadataRaw.title: How to Quickly Fix Shoulder Blade Pain | STEP-BY-STEP Guide
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe presents a simple, three-step guide to provide both immediate and lasting relief from shoulder blade pain.

Shoulder blade pain often stems from a buildup of weakness and tightness in the muscles that support the area, including the rhomboids and trapezius.

The exercises in this video are designed to address these issues by lengthening and strengthening the muscles, offering both quick and long-term relief.

Each step targets a different aspect of the problem, but they work best when done together and in order. For optimal results, be sure to complete all the exercises and focus on what works best for you.

Watch now for fast relief from shoulder blade pain!
